question: Can compensated changes to a completed aperture sum reach 120 Hz on the full public EMPAD scan without another 4D representation or scientific drift?

parameters.candidate: bounded image-sized compensated accumulator; reset on incomplete prior commands, many changed pixels, nonfinite prior sums and periodic rebase

variants: QGPU_EMPAD_DELTA_TREE=1: compensated five-stage SIMD tree instead of serial 32-lane collection; unchanged float64 oracle tolerances

outputs.result: 128-thread compensated changes adopted; 32/256-thread and tree variants rejected. Final wide ADF movement 48.6 Hz versus 30.1 Hz full integration; 120 Hz gate fails. Billion-word and repeated aperture parity pass. ARINA single 119.3–120 Hz; seven-way variability retained, not a universal no-regression guarantee.
